description: Gateway between a Modbus RTU RS485 network and an IEEE 802.15.4 wireless network (RHT-Air and other AirGates): operating mode, PAN ID, serial settings, link quality, per-child statistics and channel noise
source: Novus AirGate-Modbus manual V1.1x E (Portuguese), Modbus commands and holding register table

sources.title: AirGate-Modbus - Manual
sources.note: linked in issue #669; Comandos Modbus and Tabela de Registradores Retentivos

notes: Connection values are those of the configuration mode over USB (address 246, 115200 bit/s, no parity, 2 stop bits). In operation the gateway answers on the address in register 32 (factory 248) with the serial settings of registers 26-29; the manual does not give the factory values for those.
Functions 03 (read holding registers) and 06 (write single register), answered by the gateway itself from firmware V1.23. Requests for other addresses are forwarded to the slaves unchanged.

Not listed on purpose: the bootloader, factory-reset and restart commands (registers 0-2), the 16 security-key bytes (registers 10-25) and the protected MAC and timing registers from 1000 (except identity). DigiConfig uses them, and a wrong write can lock the device.
Changes are kept only after 1 is written to register 3; some need a restart.
Registers 36-48 and the channel noise registers are diagnostics for checking the wireless links; write the child's Modbus address to register 38 before reading registers 39-48.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.

registers.name: Operating mode
registers.description: Applied after the device restarts

registers.name: Network coordinator
registers.description: Only one coordinator per PAN ID

registers.name: CRC check
registers.description: Check the CRC of packets received on RS485 and USB; packets with a bad CRC are not forwarded

registers.name: Encryption
registers.description: All devices with the same PAN ID need the same security key (registers 10-25, not listed here)

registers.name: Multi-master time-out
registers.description: Longest wait for a slave's answer in Multi-Master mode

registers.name: Modbus address
registers.description: Factory 248, which is not a valid Modbus address, so a new gateway never clashes with another device

registers.name: RS485 parity and stop bits
registers.description: With no parity the device sends 2 stop bits and receives with 1

registers.name: USB interframe time
registers.description: 1749 follows the Modbus rule for the baud rate; raise it if the USB master has many errors

registers.name: RS485 interframe time
registers.description: 1749 follows the Modbus rule for the baud rate; raise it if an RS485 device has many errors

registers.name: Save settings to flash
registers.description: Write 1 to keep the settings after a restart; unsaved changes are lost

registers.name: Operating channel
registers.description: 11 to 25; channel 11 is 2405 MHz and each channel adds 5 MHz

registers.name: Parent link quality (LQI)
registers.description: -100 (worst) to -15 (best); 0 on USB or on the coordinator, which has no parent

registers.name: Number of children
registers.description: AirGate-Modbus in RS485-Slaves mode plus RHT-Air devices, 0 to 43

registers.name: Child address
registers.description: Modbus address of the child that registers 39-48 describe

registers.name: Child link quality (LQI)
registers.description: -100 (worst) to -15 (best), for the child chosen in register 38

registers.name: Child packets requested
registers.description: Counts since power-up and wraps at 65535

registers.name: Child packets answered
registers.description: Counts since power-up and wraps at 65535

registers.name: Channel 11 noise
registers.description: 2405 MHz, measured when the network starts; -100 (clean) to -15 (noisy)
